summary: Change parts of the body with edit operations (needs --if-version)
description:
Change parts of the body with edit operations (needs --if-version)

--edits takes a JSON array of operations, each {"name": ..., ...}: replaceNode, insertNodeBefore, insertNodeAfter, deleteNode, removeNodes, moveNode, appendNodeToEnd, setAttrs (by ADF `localId`, from `page get --outline` or `--body-format adf`), replaceText ({find, replace, count}), and replaceSection, appendToSection, prependToSection, deleteSection, insertSectionAfter (by `heading`). A `value` is Markdown, or ADF with "format": "adf". Nodes no operation touches are sent back unchanged.
